connectors.name: USGS earthquakes
connectors.limitation: M2.5+ observations from the last 30 days. Hypocenter coordinates; parameters may be revised. No inferred national attribution near borders.

connectors.name: GDELT news discovery
connectors.limitation: Bounded 250 newest matching articles in a rolling 24-hour window. Publication time is GDELT first-seen time. Source country describes the publisher and is never used as event geography. Country mentions are regional context only.

connectors.name: ACLED conflict reporting
connectors.limitation: Account permissions and licensing apply. Newest bounded page from the last seven days; not exhaustive coverage. Date has day resolution, represented at midnight UTC.
connectors.access_requirement: Authorized myACLED account and API access required
connectors.error: Authorized myACLED account and API access required

connectors.name: NASA FIRMS thermal detections
connectors.limitation: Configured bounding box; one day of VIIRS NOAA-20 NRT detections, bounded record count. Thermal anomalies can include industrial heat and are not confirmation of wildfire.

connectors.name: ReliefWeb humanitarian reporting
connectors.limitation: Newest 100 reports. Country-level reporting context only. Approved appname required by the provider.

connectors.name: OpenSky aircraft observations
connectors.limitation: Configured bounding box and bounded public ADS-B observations. No exhaustive aircraft coverage or inferred military classification. Historical storage subject to your provider agreement.
connectors.access_requirement: OpenSky OAuth API client credentials and permitted retention required
connectors.error: OpenSky OAuth API client credentials and permitted retention required

connectors.name: Authorized maritime feed
connectors.limitation: Administrator-provided licensed AIS JSON feed. Incomplete coverage. Provider must permit display and historical retention. Schema specified in docs/SOURCES.md.
connectors.access_requirement: Licensed maritime JSON endpoint and explicitly allowed host required
connectors.error: Licensed maritime JSON endpoint and explicitly allowed host required

connectors.name: CISA exploited vulnerabilities
connectors.limitation: Catalog additions, not individual incident reports. No incident coordinates or victim attribution inferred.

connectors.name: BBC world headlines
connectors.limitation: Headline and feed excerpt only. Country mentions provide regional context, not incident locations. Provider terms govern reuse.

connectors.name: NATO public announcements
connectors.limitation: Headline and feed excerpt only. Country mentions provide regional context, not incident locations. Provider terms govern reuse.

connectors.name: ECB releases and statements
connectors.limitation: Headline and feed excerpt only. Country mentions provide regional context, not incident locations. Provider terms govern reuse.
